sampleLoginPlan.feature: SauceDemo login flow — valid login, locked user, and validation errors

scenarios.title: Successful login with standard_user redirects to inventory page
scenarios.expectedResult: URL changes to /inventory.html and the page title shows 'Products'

scenarios.title: Locked-out user sees a descriptive error message
scenarios.expectedResult: Error banner is visible with text 'Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

scenarios.title: Invalid credentials show a credentials mismatch error
scenarios.expectedResult: Error banner contains 'Username and password do not match any user in this service'

scenarios.title: Missing username shows validation error
scenarios.expectedResult: Error banner contains 'Epic sadface: Username is required'

scenarios.title: Missing password shows validation error
scenarios.expectedResult: Error banner contains 'Epic sadface: Password is required'

preconditions: SauceDemo site is reachable at https://www.saucedemo.com

fixtures.shape: { standard: { username, password }, locked: { username, password }, invalid: { username, password } }

pomActions.description: Return error banner element for assertions
Click the error banner close button

coverageGaps: problem_user login behavior (broken images, wrong sort order)
Login with keyboard (pressing Enter instead of clicking Login button)

sampleCartPlan.feature: Inventory page cart management — add/remove items, badge count

scenarios.title: Adding a product to the cart increments the cart badge
steps: On the inventory page, click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Observe the cart badge in the top-right corner
scenarios.expectedResult: Cart badge appears and shows count '1'

scenarios.title: Adding two products shows badge count of 2
steps: Add 'Sauce Labs Bike Light' to cart

scenarios.title: Removing a product from the inventory page decrements the badge
scenarios.expectedResult: Cart badge disappears (no items in cart)

scenarios.title: Cart page shows all added products
scenarios.expectedResult: Cart page lists 'Sauce Labs Backpack' as a cart item

preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Inventory page is fully loaded (6 products visible)

pomActions.description: Click Add to cart for a named product
Click Remove for a named product
Click the cart link to navigate to cart
Assert product is listed in cart

coverageGaps: Cart state persistence across page navigation
